content:
B"H

# Phase Two Critique — Thirty Additional Improvements

1. Use immutable tunnel routing.
2. Recover durable receipts after disconnects.
3. Avoid duplicate command dispatch.
4. Keep one spawning action at a time.
5. Allow active agents only on disjoint scopes.
6. Require structured agent receipts.
7. Verify every agent claim independently.
8. Pin the original worktree before edits.
9. Distinguish generated from authored files.
10. Preserve public exports.
11. Check all call sites before rewrites.
12. Detect circular imports.
13. Test deterministic clocks.
14. Compare preview/export frame hashes where possible.
15. Confirm title-card safe areas.
16. Confirm captions survive camera cuts.
17. Confirm eyes remain legible at 180×300.
18. Confirm fingers do not alias into noise.
19. Confirm heel/toe silhouettes.
20. Confirm garments do not merge with limbs.
21. Confirm crossed arms remain locked.
22. Confirm pocket hands remain locked.
23. Confirm viseme changes span spoken intervals.
24. Confirm blinks are deterministic.
25. Confirm gaze is view-space aware.
26. Confirm startup restore from a clean process.
27. Confirm packaged media is self-contained.
28. Record file sizes and SHA-256 hashes.
29. Inspect representative pixels directly.
30. Keep `NEXT_ACTION` executable until all evidence closes.
